items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: Kid Ori, that's the one, Kid Ori.

ctx.x: Be sure it wasn't Kid Ori you're thinking of. I thought Kid Ori was a trombone player in Hollywood.
Kid Ori, that's the one, Kid Ori. That's Kid Ori, that's right, that's Kid Ori I'm talking about.
He still plays out in California.
